The '''VX-9 Mailoc''', also known as the '''VX-9 Redeemer''' by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] was a gunship manufactured by the [[Dromund Kalakar shipyards]] and used by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. It impressed Republic [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] so much that when they encountered it in combat they requested a ship like it. The [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] then carried out a long [[Mission to the Dromund Kalakar shipyards|operation]] to steal the VX-9 Mailoc design specifications. The mission was a complete success, and the VX-9 Redeemer was then manufactured for Republic forces.<ref name="GS" />
